findings.summary: The line self-gate is not wired into the engine (spec §1 unmet). dd/selfgate.py exposes assess_evidence/decide/harvest_eligible but has no production caller — it is imported only by tests/test_m3_line_selfgate.py. The goal line does not automatically discharge the six obligations on dd_awaiting_gate, does not deliver APPROVE/REJECT via decision_deliver, and the dd gate surface still 'carries no verdict' (decisions still travel as work.decision.v1 'published by a human', service.py:29-32). The central deliverable ('线自判路径成引擎默认') is dead code, not default path; the acceptance tests exercise only the pure functions, not the integrated self-APPROVE flow.

Spec §4 unmet: the six evidence results are never templated into progress / board evidence-note as the decision_deliver rationale payload — no code path assembles or persists the evidence because nothing gathers the six facts or calls decide().

Spec §5/S7 unmet: the harvest trigger is not actually moved to after-merge; harvest_eligible() is unused and no scheduler/harvest reactor consumes it, and the allowlist semantics change to 'release/<line-id> writable repos' is not wired against the self-gate.
